correctness.rationale: For n>=5 Aut(K(n,2))=S_n. Every selected two-subset induces an edge in a labeled graph H; its membership signature at vertex v is the set of selected edges incident to v. Distinct signatures are equivalent to no K2 component and <=1 isolated vertex: a repeated nonempty signature forces an isolated selected edge. Labelled exponential formula removes singleton components exp(-t) and isolated edges exp(-zt^2/2) from all graphs, then permits one singleton with (1+t), giving the exact all-cardinality EGF. Minimizing edges in components of size >=3 yields floor(2n/3), all minima forests with enumerated residue profiles; Cayley s^(s-2) yields D_n. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all edge sets for n=5,6 and separate EGF coefficient inclusion-exclusion reconstructs D5=80,D6=840. The all-n proof is structural, not inferred from finite counts.
